svg.aria-label: The full mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Phase 0 Intake: configuration record, citation verification: mark only or strict (stop); you skip Phase 1, giving your own sources? (question); Phase 1 Literature strategist: screens your sources, searches for what they miss, unless you say your sources only (agent); You review the sources: add or remove, optional (stop); Phase 2 Structure architect: outline and evidence map (agent); Outline approval (stop); Phase 3 Argument builder (agent); Phase 4 Draft writer: 4a pre-commitment, 4b draft and self-scores (agent); Visualization, when there are quantitative results: figure code and LaTeX inclusion code (agent); Phase aborted: you decide (stop); Phase 5a Citation compliance: corrects format and DOIs, flags a wrong source, stops on a claim not in its source (agent); Phase 5b Abstract agent, in parallel (agent); Phase 6 Peer reviewer, round 1: 6a scoring plan, 6b scores and verdict (agent); You decide (stop); Draft writer: revises, a full draft again (agent); Peer reviewer, round 2: the revised sections (agent); RAISE compliance check, warnings only (agent); Phase 7 Formatter: adds the AI disclosure and limitations if missing, places the figures, converts, compiles with tectonic or xelatex (agent); Final checklist: content, format, required elements, DOIs; compile errors fixed, warnings accepted (agent); Hard gate: a citation unverified, fabricated or unsupported, or blocked under strict? (question); Output refused: you fix it (stop); Output package (agent) | paper, as ruled: Intake: config.md, the interview [D24]; skip the search? DOI checking [O], venue policy [W], claims not to make [AI2], main.tex to replace [AD4], a file in words [AQ], research report, question, type [AV1, AV3, AV15] (stop); you skip the search? [J] (ruled); Literature strategist: screens your sources, searches for what they miss; a list over 50 entries shows its first 20 and last 5 [J, AV16] (ruled); You review the sources: add or remove, optional [J] (stop); Planner: outline and evidence map, argument map; one role for structure architect and argument builder [D43]; the structure checked against the question and the materials [AV18] (ruled); Literature strategist, resumed: the sections that need literature and have no source [AD1] (ruled); Planner again: assigns what was found [AD1] (ruled); Outline approval (stop); Planner: asks what is wrong with the structure, writes 2 alternatives; your own structure is followed as user-customized [AD2] (ruled); Draft writer: first draft, abstract, keywords, six statements, figure places [S], the disclosure names the model [N], claims list, cover letter [AV7, AV8], no self-scores [D43, D45], prose standard [AJ, AW] (ruled); Draft writer once more: the model identifier, when the list gave none [N] (ruled); Visualization, when the materials hold data, beside the writer [D43]: figures and their LaTeX, placed as its own patch [S] (ruled); Script: cite-keys, check-urls [AF] (script); Citation compliance agent, after the draft and before round 1: reads each cited source, checks the claims not to make, lists the claims off the list of intended claims [AF, AI2, AV7] (ruled); A claim the run cannot support [AF] (stop); The citation style to confirm: more than half the entries fail the same check [AV14] (stop); Script: cite-keys, check-urls, quote-check [AF] (script); Citation compliance agent again, fresh, once [AF] (ruled); Peer reviewer, round 1: fixed criteria, no scoring plan, reads the citation report [D45, AF] (ruled); The draft review does not pass: accept, an expanded revision by root cause, revise by hand and resubmit, lower the venue, or end [AD3, AV4] (stop); Draft writer: round 1 issues, a patch [C] (ruled); Peer reviewer, round 2 [D45] (ruled); Script: reference checks (script); Draft writer: reference-fix, once [K] (ruled); Script: reference checks again, failures left named [K] (script); A reference that cannot be confirmed [O] (stop); Session: compile in a copy, no formatter; the engine is the first that applies of a % !TEX program line, the class table, the venue's template, XeLaTeX [M, AV11] [4.A R2-6] (ruled); Draft writer: compile-fix, once [M] (ruled); Session: compile once more, the rest named [M] (ruled); /writing review: 4 agents [D46] (ruled); End: the final message with the numbered report, the sources only a preprint server or no index matched, and a verdict that was not Accept [D46, AG] (ruled); Draft writer: applies the findings, then the compile again [D46] (ruled); Draft writer: the anonymous copy, when the venue is double-blind [AV9] (ruled); At every patch: a structural patch, a patch that does not apply, a script failed [C] (stop); At every agent start: a model other than the configured one [D47] (stop).
